reason: C03-F02. Authorisation for version 1 of the covered-component manifest, recorded in workflow on 2 October 2026 and quoted below rather than summarised, because a record that carries my paraphrase of a decision is a record of my paraphrase. Decisions: '1. Make the covered-component set explicit and authoritative. The review target must explicitly declare which files constitute the implementation being reviewed and approved. 2. Remove automatic scope expansion from filename references. A filename appearing in source code, comments, documentation, strings, fixtures, or other covered files must not automatically add that file to the covered set. 3. Treat test suites and execution records as review evidence unless explicitly declared as covered components. Their exact hashes should remain pinned to the review so the basis of the review is reproducible, but they should not automatically become part of the reviewed-component set. 4. Changes to review evidence do not change which implementation files were reviewed, but may require new verification evidence.' Correction of the same date, on my proposal that the gate keep its own copy of the list: 'The weak point is having the gate maintain a second independent copy of the covered-file list. That creates two sources of truth and introduces synchronization risk. Replace the gate's separate copy with one canonical covered-component manifest.' Second correction, on my proposal that the manifest's own change history evidence the authorisation: 'That history should not be the sole proof of authorisation because it is stored inside the same mutable file. Otherwise, a scope change could also rewrite its own history. The manifest's internal change history is descriptive. The repository/workflow record is the independent evidence that the scope change was actually authorised.' Third correction, on my proposal that a commit suffices: 'One gap remains: a repository commit proves a scope change was recorded, not that it was authorised. A valid scope change requires both: provenance, the changed manifest exists in a repository commit; and authorisation, human approval recorded independently of the manifest. A workflow message counts as authorisation evidence only if it is persisted and referenced deterministically as a durable approval record.' This file is that durable record. Confirmed 'ALL GOOD' in workflow on reading the implementation described back to him.
scope: Version 1 declares eleven components: the four roots declared on 9 September 2026, the evidence schema, the four modules those roots import, the gate itself, and this manifest. It removes seven files that the previous derivation had added by textual reference, four of which were control suites and one of which appeared only inside a comment.
